[b]November 4-10, 2026: The November Uprisings[/b]

Word had spread quickly that the doge had been forcibly arrested by Piter Drømm, an action viewed by many of the old order and even by the common citizens to be highly provocative.

The event seemed to shake the country out of its stupor as they realised that the government which promised freedom seemed to now lean once more against the pillar of tyranny.

Immediately protests would begin in the Free Republic, as the nobelesse and common citizens urges the remaining four Princes to remove Piter Drømm and restore the doge. 

Panicked, Piter Drømm would send members of the IDF and NDF to guard the protests, which had begun to see clashes arise with local police. However, those in the NDF, including the generals in charge of the groups sent to the protest lines, would see this as an opportunity to liberate themselves from Lenstahl and Drømm. 

As a result a series of mass defections would begin, with almost 12,000 NDF soldiers across the country defecting to what the media had begun to call the Republican Peoples Army (RPA).

Although Lenstahl would freeze the accounts of those involved in the defections upon the order of Piter Drømm, the defectors would garner donations from sympathetic supporters and the funds of the Free Republic of Knygta and Deyn.

In the meantime the constitutional conventions in the other four principates would see themselves hijacked by various groups claiming to be the legitimate representatives of the people, leading to further uprisings and protests regarding the openness of thr convention process.

Malben, fearing for his own safety would retreat to the City-Confederation where he would begin to work on arming the state, moving the workers to raid the NDFs supply depots in the region.

Thus as the country descended into civil chaos, Drømm remained in Tharkønn, notably growing increasingly detached and isolated within the city and the state bureaucracy which had begun to falter in of itself.

[b]Royal Letter from His Majesty Rhes Al-Tiran, King of Tirakan, to General Ersan Velir of the Renaissance Union[/b]
[i](Sealed with the crest of the Grey Falcon)[/i]

[b]Dahr-Rav Garrison, 14th of Iralen,[/b]

To my loyal General Ersan Velir,

You have asked me whether I intend to make a plea to the nations beyond our broken borders, or rather to beg, as some would call it, for support in this struggle for Tirakans rebirth. I have considered it carefully. Our cause is just, yet our name is worthless, in the eyes of foreign statesmen, as well as in those of our very own ranks. International recognition still ties the crown to my name, but that title means little when our own soil no longer answers to it.

If foreign powers still see the banner of the Grey Falcon as legitimate, then perhaps that mere opinion can serve us. [i]I will go to (a line crossing through the last 4 words)[/i] I will send word to those who remember the old Tirakan. Those supporting your party. The merchants who used to traded our copper, before these filthy outlaws [i]tore down (a line crossing through the last 2 words)[/i], attemptet to tear down our power. All the envoys who were received in the Hall of Aelir. But I will not grovel. We shall let them know we seek partnership, not alms! And yet, as I sit here considering, I have to ask you, dear friend, for guidance. Involving international partners could destroy the balance we have worked so unforgivingly. Naerim has an steady eye on us, and the circles we are looking to involve.

You asked, too, for my counsel, on how to respond to the guerrillas that harass our convoys in the Dahris Valley. You know as well as myself, that Naerim needs to pay for funding pure evil within the very heart of this broken territory we call a country. Their hit-and-run strikes are not war, but an infection that needs to be dealt with through force and brutality. They burn our storehouses, not soldiers, so we shall take their homes. They bleed the villages, so we shall take their families. They steal from the farms, so we shall take their bread and water. You are right to call them bandits, for that is all they have become. A biproduct of a nation that worships heresy and forgets its men.

If you strike back, strike decisively. Show the civilians that the Union, not the anarchists and traitors, can protect the grain routes. And do not waver to dull your sword, by slaying those who refuse to see that we, and we only, are the solution to this ever-lasting bloodshed. The people on those borders live without law, as you have seen in your very own campaigns yourself. The fields are untended, children barter ammunition for bread, and whole towns change hands every fortnight. The rivers are clogged with burnt timber and corpses alike. That is what the Republics freedom looks like. Show the people that we bring their salvation and that they shall lay down their arms today, if they want us to protect them.

Our task is not simply to win battles, but to remind them what it means to live with faith and a body that governs, feeds, and guards its own. My throne was not destroyed, it was scattered. Piece by piece, you must gather it again.
Stand firm, Ersan. The army carries the last fragment of Tirakans soul. You have to carry this burden, on your tired shoulders, for a little longer. When the time is right, and the borders are secure, I shall make my appeal to the world not as a beggar, but as a King reclaiming his nation. 
Drakar ven Tir, Drakar ven Han.

May the four Dragons protect your life,
Rhes Al-Tiran
The only King of Tirakan

[b]The Express  9 November 2025[/b]
[b]Headline:[/b] [i]Naerim Establishes Ministry of External Affairs; Military Budget Raised Amid Border Instability[/i]

[b]NAERIM-CITY[/b]  In a decisive move to strengthen both its international standing and domestic security, our current government has announced the creation of a [b]Ministry of External Affairs[/b], alongside a significant increase of the national defense budget from 6% to [b]8% of the GDP[/b] for the upcoming fiscal year.

The announcement was made this morning by Premier Kareth Onu during a press conference in the [i]House of State[/i], where he emphasized that Naerim "must take responsibility for its own stability in a world that no longer guarantees it."

> For too long, the future of our people has been defined by the chaos around us, Onu said. We will hold our borders, protect our citizens, and extend a hand to the world. Take that Al-Thiran. [i](shows a picture of Premier Onu sticking his tongue out at the press conference)[/i]

[b]A New Step Toward Recognition
[/b]
The newly founded Ministry of External Affairs will coordinate all diplomatic communication with neighboring regions and other Shamatian nations. Its first priority will be to establish mutual recognition agreements and define the status of Naerim as an independent state, a step long resisted by both the Renaissance Union and the Holy League of Tirakan, who still claim to represent the true Tirakan.

Sources within the government confirmed that initial contacts with neutral trade partners have already begun. The Ministry is expected to release its first foreign policy paper by the end of the month.

[b]Border Crisis and Growing Tensions[/b]

While Naerims urban centers have seen reconstruction, the outer regions tell a different story.
Across the northern valleys, fighting between RU loyalists and religious militias continues to displace thousands. Satellite imagery confirms entire townships reduced to ruins, and humanitarian convoys often find themselves caught between conflicting checkpoints.
In the south, the Coastal Alliance has lost control of key roads, leading to a surge in piracy and fuel smuggling. Civilians describe life as a rolling gamble, with makeshift laws shifting from one armed group to the next.

A government report released last week estimates that over [b]2.7 million Tirakans now live without a functioning civil authority[/b], relying on local militias or clan leaders for basic governance.

[b]A Nation Standing Alone[/b]

Despite the turmoil, Naerim has managed to stabilize its own territory through strict meritocratic governance, industrial discipline, and a unique model of technocratic administration.
Officials argue that the increase in military spending is not a move toward aggression, but a shield against collapse.

> If the world still sees us as a province in rebellion, than thats their blindness, said Defense Minister Relas Tair. We are the only part of Tirakan where trains still run for relevant distances, lights still shine, and children still go to school. We intend to keep it that way. [i](Shows a picture of Naerims plans for a new high-speed rail connecting its largest 3 cities)[/i]

The Ministry of External Affairs, located in the newly built Silver Annex of Naerim-City, is expected to begin operations within two weeks. The government hopes this step will finally give Naerim a voice on the international stage and perhaps, one day, a seat at the table amongst independent nations.

[b]Editorial Note:[/b]
Tirakan remains one of the most fragmented regions on the continent. While Naerims technological rise brings new hope, the rest of the former union sinks deeper into a state of armed anarchy. For the people living between the broken borders, the question remains: how long can islands of order survive in a sea of chaos? 
Feel free to send us a letter at Naerim-City, 85744, Ashka-Af, Ashka 2!

[b]Battle of Tarnesbur | Erene 2000 | Second Flouesch Republic[/b]

As the National Peoples Army swept up remaining royalists across Nevonia one last major objective remained for the Ieweschte Revolutionär Kommando. Who was starting to become extremely anxious for how long the conflict had actually drawn on for. Esspecially with the esclating situation in the White Sea, the NVA and the Republic could no longer afford to have almost the entire NVA deployed in Nevonia. With the general collapse of the Royalist, the Republic could afford to spread out its forces more now, and the Nevonian Republicans, now becoming increasingly well armed and well organized, could be trusted to mop up the remaining republicans with little assistance from the Republic. And therefore, the IRK informed the commander of the First Panzer Division, Lieutenant General Paul Weber was informed that he needed to bring his division to surround the Tarnesbur Pocket, long cut off from royalist foerces through the joint effort of the NVA and the Nevonian Republicans. 

His orders? Simple, clear out Tarnesbur, whatever the cost and finally bring this conflict to an end. He was given autonomy on how this goal was achieved, and General Paul Weber decided to use a tatic that he had used in the beginning of the war, a spearhead of the armored forces straight towards the city center, while mechanized infantry and division artillerly would cover there flanks. The battle began at 2 am on November 11th. Artillerly from the 1st Panzer Divison would rain down across the city, attempting to water down the defenses and morale of the city. With air support premeptivly taking out any known royalist fortifications within the city and any remaning government buildings within the city in a short shock and awe campaign, air strikes and coordinated artillerly would continue for the next 4 hours in the city. Then the tanks would begin to move along the captured main road into the city, while mechanized infantry would begin to clear out suburbs, royalist defense was actually less then anticpated, and also devastated by the bombings. The siege of the city would continue for another week; slowly, though, more and more buildings flew a simple red banner to indicate that they had been captured by either Republican or NVA forces. 

Finally, on November 18th, at around 5am in the morning, the soldiers from one of the First Panzer Division's mechanized infantry divisions would raise the Floueschian Tricolor over the ruins of the royal palace. The soldier who was holding the flag was Vincent Muller, eldest son of the First Consul, Fredriech Muller. This was largely seen as the end of the battle, as by now most of the city outside of a few fortified pockets was now fully under republican control. Meanwhile, in the mountains of Nevonia, a squad of Fallschirmjäger from the 1st battalion, led by Gruppenkommandant Marc Hoffman, would begin an operation codenamed "FOXHOLE." Secretly planned by the Stase, who had found the location of the King of Nevonia through a spy in his bunker with republican sympathies, the operation would involve the recovery of the Stase asset, the king, and the prime minister, alive, if possible. The entire operation would be recorded to be later televised. Landing in the mountains, the squad would blast through the bunker doors and fight their way through the Nevonian Royal Guard; eventually, they would arrive to where the king was deeper in the structure, trying to kill himself in his private quarters like the coward he was. The gun was removed forcefully by breaking his arm; he was then dragged out along with the prime minister, who surrendered himself once his office had been captured in the bunker, and the Floueschian Tricolor was raised over a flagpole nearby the bunker. With this, the war was declared over. The King was transported to a maximum security prison near the Nevonian Border, along with other prominent Floueschian Royalists. The video would be "leaked" online later that day.

Muller would release a public speech celebrating the victory and assuring the international community that the Nevonian king would be swiftly brought to justice for his crime before ordering the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to release documents. These documents detailed the hideous atrocities of the Nevonian monarchy, from the usage of chemical weapons, mass graves, and massacre of civilians to further justify Floueschian intervention to the international community. Floueschia also immediately recognized the new Nevonian interim government in the International Alliance and called for them to be granted full membership in the alliance. The National Peoples Army would begin withdrawing from Nevonia, with the Internal Revolutionary Guard replacing them to help the new interim government establish stability; a few NVA units would remain in pre-agreed new Floueschian military bases in Nevonia.

[b]Investigation of NR Jet Crash in Former Daesunite Nuclear Test Site, Qual Atoll[/b]

[i]It had been decades since Daesun last set foot on the Northern Atolls. As live nuclear testing grew more harmful than beneficial, the sites were deemed obsolete and abandoned. But forty years later, Daesuns gaze turned north once again. Decades prior, a fighter aircraft belonging to the [nation=noflag]Neue Republik[/nation] had crash-landed on Qual Atoll, Daesuns most heavily scarred test site. At the time, the incident was ignored, there was no reason to return. But years later, new intelligence would change everything.

Rumors and urban legends began to circulate, telling of humanoid figures wandering the irradiated ruins. Naturally, Daesun dismissed these as superstition. Yet with renewed public curiosity and foreign speculation surrounding the old crash, the government decided to reopen the case. The objective was simple, locate and recover the long-lost, highly irradiated fighter jet, and return it for radiation research.

[b]November 1st, 2026[/b]

After weeks of discussion, the Daesunite military authorized a joint investigation with the Global Espionage Agency. A platoon of specialized expeditionary troops was assembled for the mission, each outfitted with advanced radiation protection suits and equipped with extensive survival and medical gear. The task force was designated Beta Force.

[b]November 12th, 2026[/b]

The extraction phase commenced. All procedures had been reviewed and rehearsed. Beta Force was to be airlifted toward Qual, a long journey across the vast northern expanse of Kianzhou. Upon approach, reconnaissance drones, shielded with radiation-hardened casings, would be deployed to survey the atoll and identify the remains of the downed aircraft. Once ground conditions were confirmed safe for landing, Beta Force would make landfall along the southern shoreline, establishing a makeshift base of operations with prefabricated tents, sandbags, and decontamination units. The mission had begun, and with it, Daesuns yearned return to the Northern Atolls. [/i]

[b]November 11, 2026: The 1st Peoples Congress[/b]

As protests and defections threatened to throw the country into complete anarchy, as if the state was not already in ruins, Piter Drømm would move to summon the representatives of the different bodies to hear their complaints, invoking the Right of the Peoples. Having requested two days prior that the respective groups send their representatives to Tharkønn, Drømm now sat in the chamber of the Gøsfodde, 145 representatives before him and three of the princes. The atmosphere was tense and dangerous.

I would first like to thank you all for coming here, began Drømm, a murmur running through the hall.

Today marks almost two months since we overcame the patriarch Mendenav, who now resides under the good care of the church, he continued, his eyes sweeping across the few members of the council of 200 who had agreed to stand.

However, in those two months, we have seen disorder, and disruption, this elicited a few nods in agreement.

Now, as we are seated in this hall, three armies stand at odds, the Republican People's Army, the Imperial Defense Force, and the National Defense Force, Drømms eyes moved across the heads of all three groups, noting the rather disheveled look of the general of the Republican People's Arm.

So I must therefore stress the importance of securing a new national government under a new administration, under peaceful terms, he continued, a small laugh was heard from the rear of those assembled.

The monarchy is dead, the patriarchate is dead, the order of the people now stands present before us, states Drømm, now leaning back from the podium, folding his arms. 

Thus, a new order, based on the will of the people must be ordained and provided, he continued.

So what will it be? He intoned, Chaos or Order? Unity or division, you must make the choice, I cannot, clearly make it for you,  stated Drømm nodding slowly before walking from the podium, a few claps were heard but overall the room remained silent until roll began to be called.

The primary issue of debate was the release of Albus Capricorn, while it was generally agreed that he had been detained unfairly, it was not agreed as to what the nature of his authority wasnor any of the princes for that matter.

They had effectively been sidelined, and the people had generally turned to their own constitutional councils, while the Princes permitted factionalism to arise. It was also another matter on whether it was true that the people didnt want the restoration of the monarchy.

Unfortunately the days session ended without a vote, and with the looming threat of strikes on the horizon, along with the increasingly delicate military situation, the lack of a vote unnerved many.

Stout yet not too hefty, their dress was unusual. Unlike the professionally dressed, this oddity dressed in what happened to be ceremonial garments. Yet when his mouth came to speak his piece of mind, a horrid, disheveled voice echoed to the dismay of many.

Duarte walked out onto his stage with an opulent frock reminiscent of Edwardian elegance. It was not much of a contest to see who had stolen the attendees' gazes. After all, Duarte belonged to one of the most affluent and influential families in the country. He could afford to cause a bit of a scene by dressing in such decadent styles.
